static_traits.name: Su Kaiwen
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；not yet接受过心理治疗；此前not yet出现与跑步或运动相关的类似问题

basic_info.main_problem: 我注意到上一次跑步时速度not如平时，这让我觉得自己干脆not要再跑步了。这种想停止跑步的感觉是在那次跑步之后才出现的。我认为工作压力和not良营养可能促成了这种感觉。问题发展到现在，我开始怀疑自己的能力，甚至考虑彻底放弃跑步。每次尝试去跑步都会出现这些想法，影响了我运动的动力。我尝试在跑步时更用力，但只会让我更沮丧。
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these negative thoughts about running are affecting my overall well-being and fitness goals, so I have come to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: 曾完成一次10公里比赛并在赛后感到非常棒，对自己感到自豪。其时保持规律训练、饮食Good，并对自己的能力充满信心，这些因素共同促成了Good表现与积极体验。

core_beliefs: I have lost my ability as a competent runner

special_situations.event: 上一次跑步时配速比平常慢
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能跑得和以前一样快，就证明I am not good enough或have not能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcing oneself to train harder in subsequent runs to make up for performance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如以前了，干脆do not跑了

special_situations.event: 在工作Increased stress且饮食not规律的时期去跑步，表现下降
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 真正有能力的人即使状态not佳也应保持最佳表现，否则就是失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores rest and nutrition and keeps intensifying training to prove oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 压力和饮食把我搞垮了，我可能已经not再是合格的跑者

special_situations.event: Every time preparing to run, recalls that slower run
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once there is one bad performance, it will keep getting worse afterward
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Runs less or avoids running to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次跑步也会很糟糕，我还是do not跑了

special_situations.event: Reflection跑步表现时只关注那次not佳的跑步，忽视以往成功（如完成10公里）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only always maintaining perfect performance counts as valuable; any single mistake equals complete failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate积极证据、贬低过去的成功来维持自我批判
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 过去的好成绩not算数，我现在就是not行

exception_events.target_problem: 在最近跑步表现下降的情境下，来访者通常会在准备或跑步过程中产生“I am not good enough/应该停止跑步”的想法，随之Reduced drive并考虑放弃跑步。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 有一次完成10公里比赛后，Su Kaiwen感到状态极佳并为自己自豪；当时训练规律、饮食Good且自信，have not出现“该停止跑步”的念头，跑步体验积极。
exception_events.reason: 线索：not同做法与情境——训练更规律、营养充足；自信水平更高，因此当次跑步表现与体验明显改善。

positive_force: Once trained regularly and successfully completed a 10-kilometer race, showing discipline and endurance
Has a certain amount of social support (several friends to chat about private matters with)
能觉察跑后身体的积极感受（跑后身体通常感觉Good）
negative_force: Self-denial与非黑即白思维，容易将一次失常等同于彻底失败
过度概括与心理过滤，忽视过去的成功只关注一次not佳表现
工作压力与饮食not规律降低训练状态
跑步Decreased motivation并出现回避倾向

target_behavior.behavior: 跑步Decreased motivation并出现“干脆停止跑步”的回避行为与消极自我评价
antecedent: 上一次跑步速度明显变慢
在准备跑步时回想起那次表现not佳
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次表现下降灾难化与过度概括，形成“I am not good enough/能力丧失”的核心认知，并以非黑即白方式评价自我，导致Self-efficacy降低与失败Anticipation
target_behavior.function: Avoids feelings of failure and self-shame, avoiding facing possible poor performance again
target_behavior.consequence: Daily physical activity level declines, overall fitness goals and physical and mental health are affected; running training frequency decreases and motivation weakens
